responsibility: Contains the generated GCC option-enum tables for the C-SKY backend, as produced from csky_cores.def by csky_genopt.sh. It enumerates every accepted -mcpu= core name, -march= architecture name, and -mfpu= FPU name and binds them to the corresponding TARGET_CPU_*, architecture integer, and TARGET_FPU_* values used by GCC’s option parser and target configuration logic.
